name: local_package_deps
title: Extract dependencies from a local DESCRIPTION file

origin.description: Extract dependency names from a local DESCRIPTION file.

arguments.name: pkgdir
arguments.text: Path to a package directory, or to a package tarball.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Which dependency fields to read. A length-1 logical NA selects Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. TRUE adds Suggests. FALSE selects nothing. A character vector keeps the known names in that order. soft means TRUE and hard means NA.

origin.details: Field names are lowercased before they are matched. Each selected field is split on commas. The version in parentheses is removed. Only the operators >, >=, ==, <=, and < are accepted, and the operator must be followed by whitespace. Any other operator stops with Invalid comparison operator in dependency: . The dependency named R is dropped. Suggests is not read when dependencies is NA.
origin.value: A character vector of package names, in field order. R is omitted.
origin.example:
dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(dir)
writeLines(c(
  "Package: toy",
  "Version: 0.0.1",
  "Depends: R (>= 3.0.0), stats",
  "Imports: remotes (>= 2.5.0),",
  "    cli (>= 3.0.0)",
  "LinkingTo: Rcpp",
  "Suggests: testthat (>= 3.0.0)"
), file.path(dir, "DESCRIPTION"))
cat(paste0("local_package_deps returns ", paste(local_package_deps(dir), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))

translation.description: Extract dependency names from a local DESCRIPTION file.

arguments.name: pkgdir
arguments.text: Path to a package directory, or to a package tarball. The default is the working directory.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: The NA object from remotes.standardise_dep selects Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. True adds Suggests. False selects nothing. A string or a list of strings keeps the known names in that order.

translation.details: Field names are lowercased before they are matched. Each selected field is split on commas. The version in parentheses is removed. Only the operators >, >=, ==, <=, and < are accepted, and the operator must be followed by whitespace. Any other operator raises ValueError with the message Invalid comparison operator in dependency: . The dependency named R is dropped. Suggests is not read when dependencies is NA. A continuation line in the DESCRIPTION keeps its leading spaces, and the comma split still separates the names.
translation.value: A list of package names, in field order. R is omitted.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from remotes.deps import local_package_deps

directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with open(os.path.join(directory, "DESCRIPTION"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(
        "Package: toy\n"
        "Version: 0.0.1\n"
        "Depends: R (>= 3.0.0), stats\n"
        "Imports: remotes (>= 2.5.0),\n"
        "    cli (>= 3.0.0)\n"
        "LinkingTo: Rcpp\n"
        "Suggests: testthat (>= 3.0.0)\n"
    )
print("local_package_deps returns " + ", ".join(local_package_deps(directory)) + ".")
